earnings.title: CrowdStrike Reports Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results
highlights: Revenue: Total revenue was $1.58 billion, a 28% increase, compared to $1.23 billion in the third quarter of fiscal 2026.
Subscription revenue was $1.50 billion, a 29% increase, compared to $1.17 billion in the third quarter of fiscal 2026.
Achieves all-time record cash flow from operations of $665 million and all-time record free cash flow of $474 million
Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) grew 27% year-over-year to $6.26 billion as of October 31, 2026, of which $419.2 million was net new ARR added in the quarter.
Subscription Gross Margin: GAAP subscription gross margin was 79%, compared to 78% in the third quarter of fiscal 2026.

quotes.text: Q3 was the best quarter in CrowdStrike’s history.
quotes.by: George Kurtz, CrowdStrike’s Founder and Chief Executive Officer

outlook: Increases FY27 net new ARR growth guidance by 1,060 basis points to 45% year-over-year growth at the midpoint
Non-GAAP income from operations $438.1 - $441.5 million $1,540.9 - $1,544.3 million
